interpretation.receiveData: Ordinary serial input; published leakage and capacitance constrain load screening, not an exact I/V curve.
interpretation.receiveClock: Manual identifies Schmitt input but does not give its hysteresis thresholds. Static table does not explicitly enumerate pins covered by clock capacitance; retain this ambiguity rather than silently applying system-clock thresholds or selecting a capacitance.
interpretation.timing: Serial receive setup/hold labels appear in the diagram, but no corresponding numeric bounds were found in the reviewed tables. Existing fixture stability budget remains an assumption.
interpretation.nextAction: Screen explicit leakage/capacitance load assumptions and seek independent pin-specific receiver evidence; preserve nominal fixture captures separately.
